description:
BigXthaPlug - Box Me Up feat. Jelly Roll (Official Music Video)

🔔 Subscribe to BigXthaPlug's channel: https://bit.ly/3SLQimL

I HOPE YOU'RE HAPPY | Out Now: https://symphony.to/bigxthaplug/i-hope-you-re-happy

Stream X’s album "TAKE CARE" – the album with his top-charting hits: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLcF8B2GVg9Ty4lmvhh9KjIYg_eslzHUCE

Lyrics:
If I lose you tonight 
Take my love and hang it out to dry 
If I lose you tonight 
Box me up and bury me alive 

Aye 
If I lose you then I lose 
I went by all the rules 
To keep your love, so I’m confused 
But yet you left me high and dry 
You loosened all my screws 
My heart feels so abused 
She dragged it till I lost my muse 
Now I'm caged in the zoo, thinkin' 'bout what I didn't do I tried to please you 
I guess that wasn’t enough because you still ended up leavin' 
My pops said, “Don’t give up because it’s out there keep believin’” 
But it feel like I’m dreamin’ 
Steady fightin’ for your love, but I’m starting to feel like I’ve been feenin’ 
Gave up, didn’t give a reason 
I think that hurt the most because now I’m just stuck here thinkin’ 
The image of you leavin’ in my head it keep repeating 
And now I’m slowly sinkin’ 
Not reachin’ out for help, just slowly fallin’ to the deep end 

If I lose you tonight 
Take my love and hang it out to dry 
If I lose you tonight 
Box me up and bury me alive 

Aye 
If I lose you then I might just go insane 
Like you might never be around 
But it's your voice that's in my brain 
I really gave you all my heart 
You gave it back with all these stains 
But I remained to keep the love I had for you, it never changed 
Stuck walking in the dark, can’t miss the puddle from the rain 
Still pulling stitches out my heart 
You ever felt that kind of pain? 
It’s time I box it up because I’ll never be the same
I’m rearranged, and at this point I’m losing more than I can gain 

If we fall off the edge 
And we’re no longer flesh 
And the darkness comes too soon 
Put a gun to my head 
And then lay me next to you 
'Cause all I know is 
If I lose you tonight 
Take my love and hang it out to dry 
If I lose you tonight 
Box me up and bury me alive 
Box me up and bury me alive
